attackerProfile: Can apply many damaging effects quickly; the fight loop is built around reaching ten damaging effects.
Has a Special Attack that can reliably interrupt Orochi's Heavy Attack during Violent Purge.
Does not need Heal Block as the primary answer, because the encounter is designed around Backfire rather than ordinary healing denial.

cheatSheet.objective: Interrupt Heavy with your Special Attack
cheatSheet.watch: Backfire is the intended burst window
Heavy can remove it in the earlier stage
A Health reset is the next phase, not victory

preparation: Choose damaging effects you can stack consistently instead of relying on one slow Debuff.
Reserve enough Power to interrupt the Heavy during Violent Purge.
Enter expecting Stun Immunity; Parry may still be useful defensively, but it is not your Stun opening.

troubleshooting.problem: Her Health immediately returns after my combo
troubleshooting.response: Ordinary damage is not the main finish route. Build damaging effects, trigger Violent Purge and create Backfire with the required Special Attack interrupt.

troubleshooting.problem: My own damaging effects turn against me
troubleshooting.response: You allowed Violent Purge to expire. Preserve Power so you can interrupt the Heavy before the timer ends.

attackerProfile: Comfort fighting at both corners and in open space; the required action changes with the active Seal.
Reliable Well-Timed Blocks and Special Attack timing help with the middle seals.
Good movement control matters more than a specific damage type because position is part of the mechanic.

cheatSheet.objective: Move Lotan to her corner and use the required Medium/Special interaction
cheatSheet.watch: Correct action from the wrong position does not count

cheatSheet.objective: Work from your corner with the required Light/Striker interaction
cheatSheet.watch: Do not drift out of position

cheatSheet.objective: Keep both Champions outside the storm and use Well-Timed Block/SP2 interactions
Use the storm as instructed and complete dodge/Heavy interactions
Dodge the penultimate hit, then dash into the final hit
cheatSheet.watch: Timing matters more than ordinary damage

preparation: Read the active Seal before acting; the same input can fail if the position requirement is wrong.
Use short combos so you can reposition for the next Seal objective.
From the third Seal onward, do not assume a Parry creates a Stun opening.

troubleshooting.problem: The correct attack does not advance the Seal
troubleshooting.response: Check position first. Lotan's mechanics combine an action with a location requirement.

troubleshooting.problem: I get hit while trying to block later Specials
troubleshooting.response: Some later Special Attack interactions are Unblockable. Use the required dodge or Well-Timed Block only where the active Seal calls for it.

attackerProfile: Can create and consume Amplify opportunities without relying on Stun.
Comfort baiting and fully dodging Heavy and Special Attacks.
Can preserve a Heavy Attack for the final 1% requirement.

cheatSheet.objective: Use Amplify interactions to reduce Will
cheatSheet.watch: Normal damage is secondary to the Will mechanic

cheatSheet.objective: Create the required charges and consume Amplify correctly

cheatSheet.watch: Path modifier can change the pressure

cheatSheet.objective: Empty Will, then land the required Heavy Attack
cheatSheet.watch: Basic combo damage alone will not finish

preparation: Enter expecting Stun Immunity; build your openings around spacing, Heavy recovery and Special Attack recovery.
Treat Will as the main progress meter. If Will is not falling, changing Champions will not fix an incorrect mechanic loop.
Read the path modifier before attempting to copy a rotation from another route.

troubleshooting.problem: I am dealing damage but the fight is not progressing
troubleshooting.response: Check Will and your Amplify interactions. The intended loop is to reduce Will, not simply race the Health bar.

troubleshooting.problem: I get punished when I try to interrupt his Heavy
troubleshooting.response: Do not intercept the Heavy wind-up. Evade it and punish the recovery as the guide calls for.
Confirm Will is empty, then use the required Heavy Attack finish.
